Microsoft Research reports that Agensh raised mean pass rate on ProgramBench’s five hardest software-rebuild tasks from 19.31% to 28.78% as GPT‑5.6-sol agents scaled from 1 to 128 under six-hour budgets.
Microsoft Research also reports a 55.06% pass rate on one pandoc task with 1,024 agents versus 33.89% with one agent; this scale result covers one benchmark task.
